name: browser-use
headline: Hive - Outcome-driven agent framework
short_description: Hive is an outcome-driven agent development framework that evolves. It benefits operations teams by automating workflows and improving efficiency. It connects to Python-based tools and workflows, enabling self-improving agents that adapt to business needs.
author: adenhq

sections.overview:
Hive is an outcome-driven agent development framework designed to automate workflows and enhance operational efficiency for teams. It enables agents to connect with Python-based tools and workflows, allowing them to adapt and improve over time based on business needs. The framework supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration for extending agent capabilities and maintains browser automation, terminal tools, and file operation capabilities. Built with a focus on practical automation, Hive helps operations teams reduce manual work by deploying self-improving agents that learn and refine their approaches to recurring tasks.
Automate the creation of specialized worker agents for sales, marketing, or operations based on natural language goals.
Implement real-time monitoring and observability for agent performance and decision-making processes.
Facilitate continuous evaluation and adaptation of agents to improve their effectiveness over time.
Deploy agents in a headless environment with CI/CD integration for streamlined operations.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/adenhq/hive`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
